mentions.name: Embarc
mentions.description: A service that crunches public filings in the financial sector, offering a large amount of data for browsing, with a logged-in dashboard that includes an RTO analysis of companies.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have a service that crunches public filings in the financial sector: https://embarc.com

There is a lot of data for browsing, though it doesn’t aim to solve specific user problems as of yet (I did take a stab with RTOs in the logged in dashboard).
